quotes.quote: Table S1: Characteristics of patients with HA20.

In a cohort of 34 patients with HA20, we show that heterozygous TNFAIP3 loss skews immune repertoires toward lymphocytes with classical self-reactive antigen receptors typically found in B and T cell lymphomas.

Peripheral blood of patients with germline TNFAIP3 mutations (in patient HA20-1 before and after treatment initiation) and 36 healthy control individuals was collected for scientific purposes after informed consent as approved by the ethics commission Halle (Saale) (project number 2014-75).

phenotype_specificity.statement: No per-person phenotype. The paper describes the cohort only in general terms.

quotes.quote: Therefore, we systematically analyzed peripheral blood B and T cell repertoires in a cohort of 34 individuals with HA20, 19 thereof as part of six affected families (table S1), using immunoglobulin heavy chain (IGH) and T cell receptor β chain (TRB) repertoire sequencing (Fig. 1A).

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Nonsense substitution, p.(Trp356Ter) (from the batch HGVS). The paper describes HA20 as caused by heterozygous germline loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: Haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20) is a severe childhood-onset inflammatory disease characterized by heterozygous germline loss-of-function (LOF) mutations in TNFAIP3 (1, 2).

concerns: The variant appears only in supplementary Table S1 of 39167656, a lymphocyte-repertoire study, with no case description, sex, age or phenotype.
No transcript stated; the batch uses NM_001270508.2.
notes_for_panel: Single table entry. Only cohort-level statements are available (the cohort is described as having germline heterozygous TNFAIP3 variants).
